contexts.text: When the proprium is presented to view...
The judgment itself, or penalty of evil, is presented in lower and lowest things.
Many other representative things are there presented conspicuously.
The ideas of their thought are representative; thus all things are presented copiously.
Thus are delightful and happy things presented without impediments.
Truths themselves are (there) presented clearly to view.
The things of the other life can never be presented to view before the sight of the body.
When celestial and spiritual things... inflow into nature, such things are presented actually.
When the Word is being read by (such) a man, it is presented by the Lord before the Angels in such beauty... AC 1768.
Their approach presents such colours.
So that it may be presented to the understanding.
This state (of temptation) when presented to view there; for all spiritual states can be exhibited to the sight there... AC 5881.
Life does not rest except in the ultimate of order, where it stands still.
This can be presented to view to the Angels.
The magicians did the like = to present the like in appearance.
To present truths so that they appear as falsities.
Sorceries = the arts of presenting truths as falsities, and falsities as truths.
By phantasies, the evil present before the eyes beautiful things as foul, and foul ones as beautiful.
In the other life, as soon as some truth is presented before good Spirits by a manifest experience, something opposite is presently presented. Explained.
How the thoughts are presented through the face.
Thus could the affections... and ideas... be presented to the life...
The quality and quantity of anyone's good... can be presented to view in the light of Heaven.
The spiritual sense is presented in Heaven, when man is reading the Word holily.
An idea of thought... about any Thing, is (there) presented to the life.
The sun of the world is (there) presented in their idea as what is black...
Things through which (uses) are presented in act, or effect...
The ideas of... any Angel or man are presented to view in the light of Heaven, when the Lord pleases.
Many things are there presented to view which with men only fall into ideas. The exterior memory is there presented to appearance like a callosity...
The whole man is presented in the deeds...
That (these truths) may be presented to apperception before the senses.
The interiors and exteriors of the mind are (there) presented to view, whenever the Lord pleases.
Through forces (endeavour) presents motion.
That these three things in the Lord... are presented in appearance outside the Sun...
Man must actually present himself to the Lord; and as the Lord actually presents Himself to man...
